items.scope: All Netskope products and services.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.
All automotive and related infrastructure vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Gallagher security products only.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
Okta issues only.
Third-party products it researches.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
MongoDB products only, not including end-of-life components or products.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by YesWeHack community hunters on products being tested on the platform with the permission of their owners, as part of Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure.

Products supported by Schneider Electric and its affiliates, including products branded Schneider Electric or any other brands owned or controlled by Schneider Electric (such as but not limited to APC, Eliwell, Proface, ProLeit, Lauritz Knudsen Electrical & Automation, etc.), excluding Aveva and RIB products.
ASR products only.

Products and technologies branded by Bull and its subsidiaries, unless covered by the scope of another CNA as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software and hardware discovered by Bull and its subsidiaries that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Roche’s medical technology products.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Snowflake products, including those of its subsidiaries, and vulnerabilities in third-party software that are discovered by, or reported to, Snowflake that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Synology issues only.
All current products/software/apps made by Logitech, Ultimate Ears, Jaybird, Streamlabs, Logitech G, Logicool, Blue, and Astro Gaming.
Proton AG issues only.
Supported Milestone XProtect products.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SRA that are not within the scope of another CNA.
Microchip Technology products only.
Yokogawa Group companies’ products and Yokogawa Group subsidiaries’ products.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.

CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Arista products only.
openGauss issues only.
Yandex issues only.

System vulnerabilities regarding the Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch Lite, and vulnerabilities regarding Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch applications for which Nintendo is the publisher worldwide.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
Current versions of LINE Messenger Application for iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows, plus LINE Open Source projects hosted on https://github.com/line.
openHarmony issues only.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Fuji Xerox and FUJIFILM Business Innovation products such as multifunction devices, printers, production printers, software, and cloud services.
All HYPR products only.
Thinkst Applied Research’s products only.
Sirius branded products, managed systems, and software projects only.
ABB issues only.
Supermicro branded products, managed system, or software projects.
Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All products and services developed and/or sold by Panasonic Group companies.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
